verifications.notes: The query selects the order by id without any user or tenant filter, and no ownership check is performed before the result is used.
The delete route only requires authentication but does not enforce an admin role or check that the target user is not the current user.
Order retrieval is performed solely by id with no filter on the current user, exposing all orders.
The first query selects an order by id without a user filter; the subsequent query that includes user_id does not mitigate the vulnerability.
The view method queries invoices by id only, without verifying that the invoice belongs to the current user.
